description: This file contains tests for the 'MapOM' operations manager implementation, specifically testing creation, retrieval, completion, waiting on operations, getting results, and listing operations. It also verifies behavior with concurrent access and error conditions related to operations management.

methods.name: TestMapOMNewOperation
methods.description: Tests creating a new operation and verifies that the operation's name is not empty and the 'Done' field is false.

methods.name: TestMapOMNewOperationNoNewUniqueUUIDsPanic
methods.description: Tests that the 'New' method panics if the UUID factory returns the same UUID for multiple calls, ensuring UUID uniqueness enforcement.

methods.name: TestMapOMGetOperation
methods.description: Tests retrieving an existing operation by name and ensures correct handling when the operation does not exist.

methods.name: TestMapOMCompleteOperation
methods.description: Tests marking an operation as complete and verifies 'Done' status updates and error handling for non-existent operations.

methods.name: TestMapOMWaitOperation
methods.description: Tests waiting on an operation to complete, handling of timeout scenarios, concurrent waits, and non-existing operations.

methods.name: TestMapOMGetOperationResult
methods.description: Tests retrieving the result of an operation, including cases where the operation does not exist, is incomplete, and is completed.

methods.name: TestMapOMListRunningEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that listing running operations returns an empty list when no operations are active.

methods.name: TestMapOMListRunning
methods.description: Verifies listing of ongoing operations correctly reports multiple active operations.
